snippet.title: Witch Hunter Izana Trailer
snippet.description:
Fight, Craft, and Cast your way across an island invaded by a force of darkness led by a charismatic vampire. Lead your group of heroes to slay her, but beware, you are what you fight.

Witch Hunter Izana, now available on Steam and Itch.io from the team at Bottled Starlight!

Check it out on
Itch.io: https://starlight-studios.itch.io/witch-hunter-izana
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2482900/Witch_Hunter_Izana/
Or follow our weekly-updated blog! https://bottledstarlight.com/
